prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
UK Independence Party Manifesto 2017 – Summary (≤500 words)

Core vision: Deliver a “real” Brexit, cut the cost of living, invest in the NHS and social care without tax rises, control immigration, strengthen defence, and reform UK democracy.

Brexit
- Six tests: Legal sovereignty (no ECJ/ECHR), full control of migration/borders, restore 200‑mile EEZ and fisheries, regain independent trade policy outside Single Market/Customs Union, no “divorce bill” and recover UK assets, complete by end‑2019.
- Fisheries: Leave CFP; repeal 1964 London Convention; require all fish from UK waters to be landed in the UK; create Fisheries Protection Force.
- Re‑introduce blue passports in 2019.

Finances and cost of living
- Fund priorities via £35bn savings: cut foreign aid to 0.2% GNI, scrap HS2, reform Barnett Formula, end EU budget contributions.
- No tax rises. Raise personal allowance to £13,500 and 40% threshold to £55,000 by 2022; raise inheritance tax threshold to £500k (aim to abolish eventually).
- Abolish TV licence (phase out over 3 years). Remove VAT on domestic energy and hot takeaway food; scrap “green” levies.

Business and jobs
- Cut business rates 20% for premises RV <£50k; tackle late payments; open public procurement to SMEs; no quarterly tax returns for self‑employed.
- Require advertising jobs to UK residents first; allow preference for under‑25 UK applicants; protect workers’ rights; curb zero‑hours abuse.
- Coastal Enterprise Zones: 50% rates cut, targeted regeneration.

Housing
- Build up to 100,000 high‑quality factory‑built modular homes annually on brownfield via a Housing Development Corporation; sold freehold to first‑time buyers under 40 with 10% deposit; stamp duty exemption; resale back to HDC at cost+inflation.

Health and social care
- Extra £11bn per year by 2021/22 (NHS + social care). Scrap hospital car parking charges.
- Lift medical school cap; free tuition for medical students (10 years NHS service) and STEM (5 years UK work).
- Integrate NHS and social care under a Department for Health and Care; toughen eligibility for non‑residents; regulate managers; end PFI.
- Mental health: +£500m/yr; 28‑day max waits; school counselling; better perinatal, addiction and veterans’ services.

Education and families
- Grammar school in every town; stronger technical/vocational routes; restore maintenance grants; end fees for STEM (conditions apply).
- Wrap‑around primary childcare (8am–6pm); £80m fund to include children with special needs.

Elderly and disabled
- Keep triple lock; protect pensioner benefits; +£2bn/yr for social care; improve carers’ rights/pay; reform PIP and Work Capability Assessments; scrap bedroom tax; ban zero‑hours for home care; major dementia plan.

Immigration and integration
- Target net migration to zero over five years; Australian‑style points and work permits; 5‑year moratorium on low‑skilled immigration; seasonal visas; 4,000 extra Border Force staff; five‑year contributions before benefits/NHS access.
- Guarantee rights of law‑abiding EU citizens resident pre‑Article 50.
- “One law for all”: disband sharia councils; ban face coverings (niqab/burqa) in public; zero tolerance of FGM, forced marriage, “honour” crimes; tougher sentencing; snap Ofsted powers against Islamist influence.

Law and order
- +20,000 police; restore stop‑and‑search; +7,000 prison officers; keep prisons open; deport foreign offenders; opt out of European Arrest Warrant.

Defence and foreign policy
- Spend a genuine 2% of GDP on defence plus +£1bn/yr; +20,000 personnel; retain nuclear deterrent; oppose EU military integration; overhaul procurement.
- Veterans’ Administration; jobs pathway (police/prisons/border); hostels and housing; curb historical prosecutions.
- Cautious foreign interventions; support NATO/Five Eyes; strengthen US ties; conditional rapprochement with Russia.

Trade, aid, and global role
- “Trade, not aid”: close DFID; cut aid to 0.2% GNI; focus on emergencies/health/clean water; ethical trade deals; commission a 500‑bed hospital ship.

Transport
- Scrap HS2; oppose Heathrow third runway; remove road tolls; back EV charging rollout; protect diesel drivers from punitive charges; support regional airports.

Environment, farming, energy, animals
- New Environmental Protection Act; protect ancient woodlands; prioritize brownfield; review EU rules; consider plastic bottle deposits.
- Agriculture: UK Single Farm Payment with £120k cap; support small, hill and organic farms.
- Animal welfare: ban live exports; mandatory CCTV in abattoirs; clear labelling; tougher cruelty sentences.
- Energy: repeal Climate Change Act; leave Paris/EU ETS; diversify supply incl. shale (no fracking in AONB); cut levies/VAT on fuel; review utility profits.

Democracy and localism
- Abolish House of Lords; create English Parliament; halve Commons to 325 under proportional representation; tighten postal voting; biennial binding referenda via citizen initiatives.
- Local binding referenda on major developments; committee governance; keep council tax low.
